build_global_context_head: build a GlobalContextHead instance with 4 conv layers and 80 classes for SCNet mask head
build_global_context_head_res: build a GlobalContextHead with conv_to_res enabled to use SimplifiedBasicBlock residual blocks
run_forward_global_context_head: run forward pass on multi-scale feature maps to get multi-class prediction and global context feature
test_loss_global_context_head: test the loss function by computing BCEWithLogitsLoss between predicted logits and ground truth labels
review_global_context_head_init: review the GlobalContextHead constructor to configure in_channels, conv_out_channels, and normalization settings
